channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Timelock in DeFi: What the Delay Actually Protects
item.description: What is a timelock in DeFi? It delays privileged changes after they are queued, giving users time to see the action and respond before it executes.

item.title: Deposit to Base Still Pending? Check, Wait or Top Up
item.description: A deposit to Base still pending usually needs time only after Ethereum confirms it; speed up an unconfirmed transaction, or add separate funds if urgent.

item.title: How to Verify Protocol Fees in a Pair
item.description: Learn how to verify protocol-owned liquidity fees on-chain by matching a pair’s LP-token mint to feeTo at the event block, even if the recipient later changed.

item.title: KuCoin to End Four Monero Markets After 58% Volume Share
item.description: KuCoin will close four Monero spot pairs on Nov. 30 after they handled about 58% of tracked XMR volume, while deposits remain shut and withdrawals stay open.

item.title: How does protocol-owned liquidity work: Fees stay in treasury
item.description: How protocol-owned liquidity works in DeFi: a treasury supplies a pool, holds the LP tokens, earns fees and marks the position to market each period.

item.title: How to Complete a TRON Swap and Verify the Result
item.description: How to trade on SunSwap: fund a TRON wallet, approve a token sale if needed, swap, and verify the confirmed transaction and received token.

item.title: Ethereum-to-Sui waits on finality; the return needs an ETH claim
item.description: Suibridge Ethereum to Sui vs Sui to Ethereum: compare steps, waits and gas. Outbound waits for Ethereum finality; return needs an Ethereum claim.

item.title: Withdraw Proceeds From a Running TWAMM Order
item.description: seo_title: Withdraw TWAMM Proceeds Through Etherscan Write Contract

item.title: Bitcoin Bridge Deposit RBF Fee Bumps and Output Checks
item.description: Will an RBF fee bump invalidate a Bitcoin bridge deposit? Usually no: the replacement can count if it keeps the required bridge output, though its txid changes.

item.title: Full range vs concentrated liquidity: a beginner’s first setup
item.description: Full range vs concentrated liquidity: beginners should start full-range for simpler upkeep; concentrated can earn more per dollar but needs range checks and rebalancing.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade is live after governance approval
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade is live on v1.21.0 after a token-weighted vote, adding cross-chain transfers and trading tools through a coordinated validator software change.

item.title: BERA Gas Funding After a USDC Bridge
item.description: How to get BERA for gas after bridging USDC: send a small amount to your Berachain wallet, then use it for approvals and swaps while keeping a reserve.

item.title: stETH vs ETH: What Changes When You Transfer or Redeem
item.description: Is stETH the same as ETH? No: stETH rebases, transfers can round by 1–2 wei, and redeeming it through Lido’s withdrawal queue takes an extra step.

item.title: Withdraw TRX or USDT First for a SunSwap Trade?
item.description: Withdraw TRX or USDT from an exchange in the right order: send a small TRX test first, keep a fee reserve, then move TRC-20 USDT to TronLink.

item.title: EU proposal puts crypto networks in Russia sanctions crosshairs
item.description: The Commission proposed targeting crypto and payment networks tied to Russia, alongside restrictions on 60 banks, putting new EU sanctions before member states.

item.title: Crypto staking rewards: receipt versus sale
item.description: When are crypto staking rewards taxable? Often when you can access or control them; selling or swapping later may create a separate gain or loss, depending on local rules.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade clears vote, targets Nov. 24 activation
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passed governance with 42.69% turnout and targets a halt at block 193,145,000 on Nov. 24 before the chain resumes on v1.21.0.

item.title: How to stay safe using Matcha swap with your wallet
item.description: How to stay safe using Matcha swap: use a saved link, protect your seed phrase, limit token approvals, verify addresses and know how to respond to a bad signature.

item.title: NYSE taps Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement
item.description: NYSE plans a 24/7 tokenized-securities venue using Avalanche for settlement while its existing system matches trades; AVAX rose as much as 10% on Nov. 9.

item.title: MoonPay seeks OCC charter for custody and stablecoin services
item.description: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would handle stablecoin issuance, redemption and reserves, plus custody and conversions, if the OCC approves its application.
